full_text: A warehouse receives 12 independent orders. Each order has a 10% chance of arriving late. Under a binomial model, what is the probability that at least 3 orders arrive late?
Five picking times are 8, 10, 10, 12 and 15 minutes. Find the arithmetic mean and sample variance.
A repair desk receives a Poisson mean of 4 requests per hour. What is the probability of at most 2 requests in one hour?
Package weights are normally distributed with a mean of 500 grams and a standard deviation of 10 grams. Find the probability of a weight above 520 grams.
A scanner flags 80% of damaged parcels and 5% of undamaged parcels. If 2% of parcels are damaged, what is the probability that a flagged parcel is damaged?
